facts.fact: Harare Institute of Technology hosted a two-day Zimbabwe University Libraries Consortium workshop training librarians from more than 22 state universities on assistive technologies (screen reader, Braille and reading devices), with equipment funded by a USD 220,000 grant secured by the consortium for its member libraries (HIT, 2026-06-10).
facts.system: ZULC Librarians' Training on Assistive Technologies
